title: Guard or handrail post at base

checklist.item: Guard height and handrail height are dimensioned from the walking surface or stair nosing and meet the building code.
checklist.why: Height is the first thing checked, and it is measured from the finished surface.

checklist.item: Openings in the guard do not pass the sphere size the code sets (4 in / 100 mm in most locations).
checklist.why: Wide openings are a child-fall hazard and a code failure.

checklist.item: The post anchorage and the structure it fastens to are shown, sized for the code guard load.
checklist.why: The base connection is where guards fail.

checklist.item: Where the post penetrates a waterproofed deck or roof, the penetration is flashed or the post is side-mounted.
checklist.why: A core-drilled post through a membrane is a leak at every post.

checklist.item: Handrail has a graspable profile, the required wall clearance and extensions at top and bottom.
checklist.why: Graspability and extensions are accessibility requirements.

checklist.item: Materials, finish, weld or fastener type and weep holes in hollow sections are noted.
